# yd-skillset

Dual-target Agent Skills repo — the same `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` set installs into Claude Code and Codex CLI. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are kept **byte-identical** (Codex reads the former, Claude the latter); the pre-commit hook rejects any commit where they differ. Both files, and every harness manifest, are generated from `plugin.source.json` + skill frontmatter by `scripts/generate.py`. See [README.md](README.md) for install and authoring.

Plugin name: `yd-skillset`. Marketplace name: `yd-skillset`.

## Skills shipped

<!-- SKILLS:START (generated by scripts/generate.py — do not edit) -->

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `algo-rewrite` | Whole-codebase algorithmic rewrite pipeline for any language — inventory every algorithm, data flow, and feature with CPU/memory complexity, triage through SIMD / concurrency / library-first / hot-cold lenses, ideate greenfield replacements under a no-compatibility rule, adversarially refute ideas in independent agents, settle survivors by A/B/C benchmark shootout (red-first TDD, zero-alloc hot paths, proportional speed-vs-simplicity adoption judgment), assemble winners into a fresh-file sibling v2 with class-map tests, a blind adversarial edge audit, and deterministic boundary enforcement at every trust boundary, audit feature parity with a gap-hunter agent that can force full re-iteration. |
| `algo-tune` | Scaled-down, in-place sibling of algo-rewrite for small targets — a function, class, or single file. |
| `harden` | Iterative, low-noise hardening review that only fixes proven defects — boundary violations, concurrency bugs (data races/deadlocks), resource/lifetime errors (leaks, use-after-free, double-release, dangling references), and garbage/uninitialized data. |
| `mastermind` | Meta-skill that turns the expensive main-thread model into a pure decision-maker — every file read, search, build, edit, and web lookup is executed by cheaper-model subagents; the main thread is forbidden all direct IO and tools except agent dispatch, skill invocation, and the todo list. |
| `msvcpp-toolkit` | C++ language toolkit, MSVC/Windows-first — the language-specific half of the algo-rewrite and harden skills. |
| `test-practice` | Language-agnostic testing rulebook — the testing half of algo-rewrite and harden. |

<!-- SKILLS:END -->

## Editing

Source of truth is `plugin.source.json` (repo metadata) plus each `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` frontmatter. Edit `AGENTS.md` only (never `CLAUDE.md` — it is a generated byte-copy), then run `python scripts/generate.py` (or `--check` to verify freshness + byte-identity). Do not hand-edit the generated manifests or the table above.
